result.summary: The image shows a residential street with a signalized intersection that lacks visible pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals. Parked vehicles along the curb create significant visual obstructions between the sidewalk and the roadway, increasing risk for pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: A signalized intersection exists without any painted crosswalk markings, making pedestrian crossing points ambiguous for drivers.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Continuous on-street parking blocks sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street along the curb

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection has vehicle traffic lights but no visible pedestrian signal heads to indicate safe crossing intervals.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility by moving pedestrians past the line of parked cars.

result.summary: This residential intersection is controlled by traffic lights but lacks marked crosswalks and visible pedestrian signals, forcing pedestrians to cross a wide roadway without clear priority. While sidewalks are in good condition, the design prioritizes vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety and comfort.

hazards.name: Absence of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks are visible at the signalized intersection, reducing driver awareness of potential pedestrian crossings.

hazards.name: Wide roadway crossing
hazards.description: The wide street width increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic without a refuge island.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings to delineate pedestrian paths and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions to reduce crossing distance and prevent parking too close to the intersection, improving sightlines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane residential street with a signalized intersection that lacks marked crosswalks. Pedestrians face a long, unprotected crossing distance across several lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The road is very wide with multiple lanes, requiring pedestrians to be in the roadway for a long duration without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: Despite being a signalized intersection, there are no painted markings to guide pedestrians or alert drivers to their presence.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area in the center of the image.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median or refuge island to break up the long crossing distance and allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.
